title: Smart Shift
description: A small QoL mod that enhances the functionality of the Shift key
body:
**Smart Shift** lets you quickly collect smelted items from furnaces by simply holding Shift.

You can also transfer items directly from your hand into containers while holding Shift.

Hold Shift and right-click with seeds to automatically plant crops in a 3x3 area.
